Why He Asked for an All-White House

titles: "I'm Not Exaggerating, This Will Be a City"
Why MrBeast Spent $10M on One Village
clips.story: Kids in this part of Ghana are trapped in illegal child labor, so MrBeast spent a year and almost $10 million turning an empty field into a whole village. Then the ribbon wouldn't cut. 😅
clips.question: Is this the best thing MrBeast has ever done?
clips.pinned: Same spot, one year apart. Homes, a school, a farm, clean water and a playground. Best MrBeast video ever? 👇

titles: Why Free Lunch Stops Child Labor
clips.story: 325 kids shared one building that flooded every time it rained, so most stayed home and worked on cocoa farms. MrBeast built 10 classrooms and is feeding every kid every school day for 5 years. 🏫
clips.question: Should every school give kids a free meal?
clips.pinned: Kids who get a free meal at school are much more likely to show up. And kids in school aren't on the farms 📚 Thoughts? 👇

titles: "Any Moment Now It's Going to Erupt"
Why Everyone Here Was Getting Sick
clips.story: This community was drinking unsafe water and getting sick. MrBeast drilled a well, hooked it to solar power and water towers, and now every home has running water. 💧
